string.text: It's a strange kind of artifact called a Dummy. It's stuck to the wall of my backpack. Gives off a faint greenish glow.
Jelly
Concentrate of the Jelly anomaly. When the jar is broken, a new anomaly is formed.
Unknown anomalous formation. Floats slightly in the air, while being quite heavy.
Spiral
An artifact with a bizarre shape resembling a spiral.

Viscous substance. Ultra-hazardous colonies of mutated bacteria. Can be found near Witch's Jelly anomaly.\nSpecificity: Very dangerous anomalous formation, store only in a protected container such as an R1 capsule.
Jelly
The result of artifact modification. It inherits the properties of its parent artifacts, including negative ones.
Black Gravi
The result of gene modification of the Jelly artifact. Protects against parasite spores, eliminates the possibility of contracting a disease.

Consists of liquid metal of anomalous origin. It is formed near "Acid Fog" anomaly after an emission, stays in contact with the body for a short time and then evaporates.

Cheap artifacts in the form of metal fragments and construction debris. While they have no useful properties for your average stalker, they are useful to scientists and researchers only for radiation measurements.

Cheap artifacts in the form of metal fragments and construction debris. While they have no useful properties for your average stalker, they are useful to scientists and researchers only for radiation measurements.
Unique artifact. Rarely appears in clusters of "Mincer" anomalies.
Appears in anomalous clusters. It helps prevent fainting, restores strength, and shields against psi effects.
Born in a Mosquito Bald anomaly. This artifact can be found in a few parts of the zone.
It is formed by the "Heat" anomaly at high temperatures. Externally, it looks like a blackened drop-shaped formation with a glossy surface covered with cracks.

A powerful electro-magnetic super-artifact. It generates a directional disintegration field. When activated, it releases a strong force field that turns anything it hits into "Jelly". Its origin is a complete mystery. It clearly contains dielectric elements, but nobody knows under what physical conditions it forms.
An artifact derived from a weak energy anomaly, with no practical use.

Super-artifact of the second level. Appears in anomalous clusters. Has the ability to scare away monsters while attracting a controller. When panicking monsters, it loses its anomalous energy and can vaporize. Level of anomalous energy: very high. Cost: very high.

Artifact originated through a transmutation. High cost. A viscous substance resembling a sticky mass, but very strong. Tends to spread into crevices. Rumor has it that when this artifact is worn on the belt, it spreads into damaged areas of the suit and then solidifies there, thus patching holes and damage.

Super artifact with an unstable gravitational field. A throwing object that, after hitting the floor or an obstacle, fires into a living body. Once hit, is fired at the next living body, until it falls or hits an inanimate object. After which it can be picked up.
Large flying fluff, leaves heavy burns when it hits a body. It accumulates in lowlands, pits and hollows. Rises into the air in a wind or explosion. Spewed from a buildup of "burning fluff."
An outgrown case of Mincer anomaly activity. Apparently, you can get such a nice rounded shape by subjecting the anomaly to thermal effects. An expensive artifact.
The origin of this type of artifact, as well as the name is shrouded in mystery. Valued among the researchers of the Zone.
Artifact of thermal origin. A transparent shimmering sphere.

When you hold this mystery of the Zone in your hands, you can feel your skin becoming rough and less sensitive. It is still easy to penetrate with a bullet, but it is much harder to cut it. Can be found near "Black Needle" anomaly.
It is generated by the "Mosquito Bald" anomaly. Elemental artifact with a directed magnetic-gravity anomaly.

It is usually found near "Mosquito Bald" anomalies. An elemental artifact with a directional magnetic-gravitational effect. A stronger variant also exists - the 'Strong Gravitational Artifact'. It allows the user to carry an additional 4 kg of weight.

It is usually found near "Mosquito Bald" anomalies. When in contact with the body, it emits directed radiation that increases stamina. Because it's relatively easy to find, it doesn't fetch a high price.
An elemental artifact of organic nature. A bundle of tough lichen fibers of a dirty rusty color, that can be found near their parent anomaly with the same name. It has no useful properties.

Crystallizes inside 'Stinging Fluff' anomalies. This artifact removes radiation from the body naturally - mainly through the ears, along with a certain amount of blood. It can also cause bleeding from other orifices. It doesn't appear very often, but it's quite effective, which is why it maintains a stable and decent price on the artifact market.

Reminiscent of 10-centimeter needles. These artifacts appear stuck in the ground near their parent anomaly, slightly rippling. They balance perfectly on their tip and can even be poked into a wall or ceiling at any angle without falling. They're completely safe to handle and don't require a container. From 3 to 7 meters away, your detector will pick them up with a distinct sound. While equipped, they provide temporary protection from psi effects, and blind dogs seem to lose track of you.

This artifact is what happens when a careless stalker gets too close to a "Stinging Fluff" anomaly. It constantly pricks and stings the wearer's skin, regardless of how it's carried or attached. However, it effectively cleanses the body of radionuclides. Quite common and relatively cheap.
Very rarely found near Burner anomalies. This artifact is extremely hard to come by - few stalkers have even seen one. It has a surprisingly pleasant shape and an equally pleasant price.

An elementary artifact of gravitational nature. It has a torus shape, which explains its name. Born in a Mosquito Bald anomaly. There are at least two known varieties of this artifact: the regular one and the "glass bagel."

Metal debris that spends enough time inside gravitational anomalies can develop the ability to generate a powerful directed magnetic field. This one is a fragment of a transmission shaft. The Magnet is a potent gravitational artifact with a strong one-way pull. It's highly valued for making gravitational weapons and anti-gravity equipment. Its behavior is quite bizarre - it constantly dances and bounces half a meter into the air, floats unsteadily, shakes, and can even cling to walls or ceilings. It forms near the "Mosquito Bald" anomaly, is safe to handle without a container, and gives off a unique signal on the sound detector from 15-20 meters away. It contains a high level of anomalous energy.
